resources.string: Module operation failed. Grant Root permission, install and enable the matching wanBox module, then retry. Invalid configurations keep the last working snapshot.
Module networking is managed independently. This Android Service option does not apply; its saved value is retained.
Both module ZIPs preserve data by default. Prepare a clean installation or keep only nodes/subscriptions here before updating.
Install either module ZIP directly. Existing App data and module configuration are preserved.

This immediately stops the proxy and clears nodes, subscriptions, route rules, settings and module runtime configuration. A full App backup and private module archive are retained. Continue, then install either module ZIP. The App will restart.

This immediately stops the proxy, keeps nodes/subscription groups and removes route rules, other settings and module runtime configuration. A full App backup and private module archive are retained. Continue, then install either module ZIP. The App will restart.
Data preparation finished. You can now install either module ZIP. A full backup is available in this page.
Data preparation is incomplete. Check Root/module availability and stop node tests, then return here to continue. Backups are retained and reconnect is blocked while preparation is pending.
